name: Dr. Yasmina Belkacem
title: Senior Research Fellow, Education and Skills
organization: Tell Atlas Centre for Youth Studies
bio: Studies how secondary and vocational education shape first jobs for young Algerians. Coordinates a multi-year school-to-work tracer survey across three wilayas.

name: Prof. Karim El-Sayed
title: Professor of Labour Economics
organization: Nile Delta Institute for Youth Labour Research
bio: Works on informal employment and occupational health among young workers in urban Egypt. Advises municipal programmes on safer apprenticeships.

name: Ms. Salma Ben Omran
title: Health Policy Analyst
bio: Analyses how local health governance affects young people’s access to primary care. Her recent work maps youth-friendly clinic coverage in eastern Libya.

name: Mr. Mohamed Lemine Ould Cheikh
title: Programme Manager, Digital Governance
bio: Runs pilots that let young citizens track local budgets through simple mobile tools. Previously trained municipal staff on open-data publishing.

name: Dr. Nadia Benjelloun
title: Director, Women in Technology Research
bio: Leads research on why young women leave technology degrees before graduating. Designs mentoring schemes with coding schools in Casablanca and Fès.

name: Prof. Hichem Gharbi
title: Professor of Rural Sociology
organization: Cap Bon Centre for Rural Youth Studies
bio: Researches the role of young women in family farms and agricultural cooperatives. Has led field studies across the north-western governorates.

name: Codjo Hounkpatin
title: Consultant, Agricultural Finance
bio: Helps young farmers’ groups design savings and input-credit schemes. Works closely with rural microfinance cooperatives in southern Benin.

name: Dr. Aminata Ouédraogo
title: Research Fellow, Education Finance
bio: Tracks how household spending and public budgets keep adolescents in school. Her current project costs second-chance education for out-of-school youth.

name: Ms. Djamila Tavares
title: Senior Analyst, Youth Transitions to Work
organization: Mindelo Institute for Skills and Work
bio: Analyses labour-force survey data on graduates in small island economies. Focuses on tourism, the blue economy and seasonal work.

name: Dr. Serge Kouassi
title: Policy Advisor, Youth Employment
bio: Advises on public works and apprenticeship programmes for young people in Abidjan. Also studies the health risks of informal urban jobs.

name: Fatou Ceesay
title: Programme Manager, Adolescent Health
bio: Coordinates peer-educator networks on sexual and reproductive health in the Kombo districts. Works with district councils to include youth in health planning.

name: Prof. Akosua Boateng
title: Director, Civic Technology Programme
bio: Studies how digital platforms change young people’s participation in local government. Runs an annual civic-tech fellowship for university students.

name: Dr. Mamadou Saliou Bah
title: Associate Professor, Digital Inclusion
organization: Fouta Djallon Institute for Digital Futures
bio: Researches the gender gap in mobile internet use among young Guineans. Works on low-cost digital-skills curricula for secondary schools.

name: Ms. Nhima Sanhá
title: Consultant, Gender and Rural Livelihoods
bio: Documents young women’s work in rice and cashew value chains. Supports producer groups in negotiating fairer prices.

name: Mr. Emmanuel Kollie
title: Research Fellow, Agricultural Value Chains
bio: Studies how young agripreneurs finance small cassava and rice processing businesses. Previously ran a rural youth enterprise fund in Bong County.

name: Dr. Oumou Traoré
title: Senior Analyst, Youth Financial Inclusion
organization: Niger Bend Centre for Inclusive Finance
bio: Evaluates mobile-money and financial-literacy programmes for young adults. Her work links school-based savings clubs to later business start-ups.

name: Mr. Habibou Moussa
title: Policy Advisor, Education and Skills
bio: Advises on vocational training for young people in pastoral and mining regions. Focuses on short, certifiable courses linked to local jobs.

name: Dr. Chiamaka Eze
title: Programme Manager, Youth Livelihoods and Wellbeing
bio: Manages livelihood programmes that pair job training with mental-health support. Has worked with youth groups in Enugu, Lagos and Kano.

name: Prof. Ousmane Ndiaye
title: Director, Health Governance Programme
bio: Leads research on decentralised health financing and youth participation in health committees. Teaches health policy to postgraduate students.

name: Isatu Kamara
title: Senior Lecturer, Governance and Digital Public Services
bio: Researches how young people use digital channels to report problems with public services. Co-designs feedback tools with city ward councils.

name: Mr. Komi Agbéko
title: Consultant, Digital Skills for Young Women
bio: Designs community coding and digital-marketing bootcamps for young women. Tracks graduates’ earnings for twelve months after training.

name: Dr. Mireille Ngo Nkot
title: Research Fellow, Gender and Agrifood Systems
bio: Studies land access and cooperative membership for young women farmers. Works across the Centre and South-West regions.

name: Mr. Aristide Yangongo
title: Senior Analyst, Rural Finance
bio: Analyses village savings groups and their reach among young farmers. Focuses on rebuilding rural credit after displacement.

name: Ms. Achta Mahamat Saleh
title: Policy Advisor, Education Financing
bio: Advises on budget lines for girls’ secondary education and teacher deployment. Has led public-expenditure reviews in several provinces.

name: Dr. Arsène Mabiala
title: Programme Manager, Youth Skills and Employment
bio: Runs apprenticeship partnerships between training centres and employers in Pointe-Noire. Studies which trades lead to stable work for young people.

name: Prof. Nathalie Kabongo
title: Director, Youth Employment and Health Research
bio: Leads studies on the health and livelihoods of young people in artisanal mining areas. Supervises a network of field researchers in the eastern provinces.

name: Dr. Ramón Esono Ondo
title: Professor of Public Health
organization: Río Muni Centre for Health Policy
bio: Researches adolescent health services and how they are governed at district level. Teaches epidemiology and health-systems management.

name: Ms. Prisca Moussavou
title: Consultant, E-Government and Youth Participation
bio: Advises municipalities on online services and youth consultation platforms. Previously coordinated a national youth hackathon on public data.
